title: It's Rising Season! What Are You Rising Above!?

top_liked.text: I was told over and over again that my dead relatives were in heaven, keeping an eye on us at all times. (as if puberty wasn't uncomfortable and awkward enough already. Thanks granny...)

I used to believe that life is meaningless without Christ.
